title: fisc extraction manifest
description: data/extracted/<doc_id>/manifest.json. THE ONE CONTRACT IN THIS TREE BETWEEN TWO LANGUAGES: tools/extract.py writes it and internal/corpus reads it. Neither imports the other and neither shares a type, so this file is where they agree.

schema_version.description: Pinned on both sides. A reader on the wrong version parses this file happily and then reports every page as "no such page", which is a documented NORMAL result -- so the version is what has to fail, loudly.

source_sha256.description: Computed by extract.py, which deliberately does NOT read data/sources.yaml: fisc verify cross-checks it against the registry, and two parties recording it independently is what makes that a real check.

warnings.description: Every distinct line poppler wrote to stderr. NOT failures: poppler has no structured error channel and exits 0 for a damaged xref and an unread metadata key alike. An empty errors array is not a promise that every page came out whole.

errors.description: One artifact the extractor could not produce. The page it names has NO artifact: extract.py writes nothing rather than something plausible and wrong.

artifacts.description: Two substrates per page, both needed: pages/pNNNN.txt is pdftotext -layout, carrying the printed column grid in runs of spaces, and geometry/pNNNN.json is -bbox word boxes. THE KEY GRAMMAR IS PART OF THE CONTRACT -- a reader resolves a page by computing this path.
